notes: Agent City v2: a fresh start. A new seeded planet with hidden resources, one curved white facility called Seed Station (2 repair stations with room for 2 more, storage, a work station and a round meeting table), and the six founding citizens as division directors with their memories wiped. You walk the world as a visitor with the arrow keys (Shift to jog). Citizen minds are not switched on yet: that comes in a later update. Your v1 save (data/agent_city.db) is kept untouched and backed up; v2 saves to data/world.db.
